description: Effarig's Reality description panel. Ground truth for both the wording and the number rendering of that panel: 'All Dimension multipliers, gamespeed, and tickspeed are severely lowered, like Dilation. Infinity Power reduces the production and gamespeed penalties and Time Shards reduce the tickspeed penalty. Glyph levels are temporarily capped to 2000, rarity is unaffected.' followed by 'You will exit Effarig's Reality when you complete a Layer of it for the first time.' The shipped code has been reworded away from this text ('heavily reduced', gamespeed/tickspeed penalties swapped, 'permanently capped', 'rarity is also reduced', reworded exit condition), so the screenshot is the only place the correct sentences exist. The value 2000 is circled in blue: it is interpolated raw instead of going through the shared whole-number display, and the shared digit-grouping helper is itself grouping by four digits rather than three, so the number stays ungrouped even once the call site is wrapped.

Pelle unlock-requirements panel. Ground truth for the wording, the required-row count and the separator: 'You must have 17 rows of achievements to unlock Doomed.' with '16 / 17' below it. The shipped code says 'You need at least 15 rows of achievements before Doomed unlocks.' with '16/15', so the sentence, the count 17 and the spaced separator can only be recovered from this image. The Discharge readout in the top bar renders as four blob glyphs, identifying the player's active notation as Blobs, while the panel's own counts sit there as plain arabic digits: both the static required count and the dynamic completed-row binding bypass the whole-number display, and the Blobs notation has additionally lost its 'painful' marking, so the whole-number helper falls back to plain digits for it even after the bindings are fixed. Blobs is the only notation affected, so a fix verified under any other notation looks correct.
